How often should I have Expert Tile & Grout Cleaning performed in my Westminster home, given the local conditions? Given the frequent high foot traffic and the issue of hard water mineral deposits in Westminster, we generally recommend professional cleaning every 12 to 18 months. High-use areas in prevalent older homes (1960s-1970s) may benefit from cleaning every 9-12 months to prevent permanent discoloration and microbial growth. Will your cleaning process damage the grout or natural stone tile found in many Westminster homes? Absolutely not. We use specialized, high-heat, low-pH solutions tailored for the natural stone and ceramic tile commonly seen here. Our pressure is meticulously regulated to remove grime without etching the tile or degrading the grout lines. We follow up with sealing to protect your surfaces from future damage. How does the high indoor humidity in Westminster affect my bathroom grout, and what can you do about it? High indoor humidity accelerates the growth of pink and black mildew in bathroom grout. Our process includes a sanitizing rinse that neutralizes these organic contaminants.
